item.title: [News] Higher Ed bargaining team declares impasse
item.description: Our bargaining team declared impasse after Aug. 5-6 mediation while management continued proposing cuts to rights, health care and real wages.

item.title: [News] El equipo de negociación de educación superior declara un punto muerto
item.description: Nuestro equipo declaró un punto muerto tras la mediación del 5 y 6 de agosto mientras la gerencia mantenía recortes a derechos, salud y salarios reales.

item.title: [News] Higher Ed mediation continues with major issues unresolved
item.description: Higher Ed mediation continues in August with COLAs, steps, health care, layoffs, bumping rights and contracting out still unresolved.

item.title: [News] We made noise. Management moved on steps.
item.description: Our bargaining team credits worker action with pushing management off its original step position. The movement matters, but 0% COLA and major takeaways remain.

item.title: [News] Workers turn up the pressure after another disappointing session
item.description: Management kept pushing four years without COLAs and attacks on health care, layoffs and workplace protections as members expanded the strike pledge.

item.title: [News] Los trabajadores aumentan la presión tras otra sesión decepcionante
item.description: La gerencia mantuvo cuatro años sin COLA y ataques a la salud, los despidos y las protecciones laborales mientras crecía el compromiso de huelga.

item.title: [News] More than 140 rally at Oregon State for fair classified staff contract
item.description: More than 140 members and supporters rallied at McNary Field and marched to Kerr Administration Building on June 30, the day our previous contract expired.

item.title: [News] Management still offers 0% COLAs and a 19-year step path
item.description: EOU classified staff showed up in force as management kept 0% COLAs, weakened the step system and attacked layoff and contracting-out rights.

item.title: [News] La gerencia mantiene COLA de 0% y una escala salarial de 19 años
item.description: El personal clasificado de EOU se hizo presente mientras la gerencia mantuvo COLA de 0%, debilitó los escalones y atacó derechos de despido y subcontratación.

item.title: [News] July 16 membership meeting moved to MU 215
item.description: The July 16 Local 083 membership meeting has moved from MU 211 to MU 215 after a double-booking. Join us at noon for TOGO'S sandwiches.

item.title: [News] Our union bargaining update: 0% COLAs and a 19-year step path
item.description: Our bargaining team reports that management's latest offer includes zero percent COLAs over four years, a 19-year step path and proposed rollbacks to member rights.

item.title: [News] 3 actions Local 083 members can take to win a fair contract
item.description: Email Oregon State University leadership, sign the strike pledge when it arrives and build our union for a fair contract.

item.title: [News] Management arrives without an economic proposal as workers rally
item.description: Management came to the table without an economic proposal while hundreds of workers rallied statewide for COLAs and respect.

item.title: [News] La gerencia llega sin propuesta económica mientras los trabajadores se manifiestan
item.description: La gerencia llegó a la mesa sin propuesta económica mientras cientos de trabajadores se manifestaron por COLA y respeto.

item.title: [Event] Rally June 30 at McNary Field
item.description: Join coworkers at McNary Field for food, lawn games, and a strong show of unity. Management is offering no raises and no cost-of-living adjustment for four years, and members are showing up for real raises and a fair contract. | Date: 2026-06-30 | Time: 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM | Location: McNary Field

item.description: Nuestro equipo propuso aumentos ligados a la inflación, salud protegida, pago por antigüedad y un contrato de dos años mientras la gerencia retuvo su oferta salarial.
